actions.create_idea.description: Save a new idea to your Buffer Idea Bank.
actions.create_idea.props.aiAssisted.des: Mark this idea as created with AI assistance.
actions.create_idea.props.groupId.descri: The column on the Ideas board to add the idea to. Leave empty to keep it out of any column.
actions.create_idea.props.imageUrls.desc: Public URLs of images to attach to the idea.
actions.create_idea.props.text.descripti: The main body of the idea.
actions.create_idea.props.title.descript: A short title or headline for the idea.
actions.create_post.description: Create a post in Buffer and add it to the queue, share it next, share it now, or schedule it for a custom time. Each run also loads your channel list (one extra Buffer API request, counted against your plan limit; Free: 600 a day).
actions.create_post.props.channelIds.des: The Buffer channels to publish to.
actions.create_post.props.dueAt.descript: When to publish the post. Required when Share Mode is "Schedule for Custom Time". ISO 8601 (UTC).
actions.create_post.props.imageUrls.desc: Public URLs of images to attach to the post.
actions.create_post.props.linkUrl.descri: A link to share. On Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and Substack it becomes a link preview card when no images are attached; otherwise it is added to the end of the text.
actions.create_post.props.mode.descripti: When and how the post should be published.
actions.create_post.props.saveToDraft.de: Save the post as a draft instead of scheduling it. Drafts are not published until explicitly scheduled.
actions.create_post.props.schedulingType: Use "Automatic" for channels Buffer can publish to directly. Use "Notification" for channels that require manual publishing via the Buffer mobile app (e.g. Instagram personal accounts).
actions.create_post.props.text.descripti: The text content of the post.
actions.create_post.props.youtubeCategor: The video category. Required when a YouTube channel is selected; ignored for other channels.
actions.create_post.props.youtubeTitle.d: The video title. Required when a YouTube channel is selected; ignored for other channels.
actions.create_post_ai.description: Create, schedule or draft a post on one Buffer channel.
actions.create_post_ai.props.channelId.d: The channel to post to, from List Channels.
actions.create_post_ai.props.dueAt.descr: Future publishing time in ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z or 2026-12-01T11:00:00+02:00. Only with customScheduled. Any other format fails without creating a post.
actions.create_post_ai.props.ideaId.desc: The idea this post comes from, from List Ideas.
actions.create_post_ai.props.imageUrls.d: Public http(s) URLs of images to attach.
actions.create_post_ai.props.linkUrl.des: A link to share. On Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and Substack it becomes a link preview card when no images are attached; otherwise it is added to the end of the text.
actions.create_post_ai.props.metadata.de: Service-specific settings keyed by service, as in the Buffer API, e.g. {"facebook":{"type":"post"}}, {"linkedin":{"firstComment":"..."}} or {"youtube":{"title":"...","categoryId":"22"}}.
actions.create_post_ai.props.mode.descri: addToQueue (default), shareNext, customScheduled or shareNow (publishes immediately).
actions.create_post_ai.props.saveToDraft: yes to save the post as a draft that is not published. Default no.
actions.create_post_ai.props.schedulingT: automatic (default): Buffer publishes. notification: Buffer sends a reminder to publish manually from the mobile app (needed for Facebook groups and Instagram personal profiles).
actions.create_post_ai.props.tagIds.desc: Tags to file the post under, from List Tags.
actions.create_post_ai.props.text.descri: The body of the post. Optional only when an image is attached.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_post.description: Delete a Buffer post for good.
actions.delete_post.props.postId.descrip: The post to delete, from List Posts.
actions.edit_post.description: Change the text, time, media, tags or settings of a Buffer post.
actions.edit_post.props.clearMedia.descr: yes to remove all media from the post. Default no.
actions.edit_post.props.dueAt.descriptio: New future publishing time, ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00Z. Implies Share Mode customScheduled.
actions.edit_post.props.imageUrls.descri: Replaces all media on the post with these images. Leave empty to keep the current media.
actions.edit_post.props.metadata.descrip: Service-specific settings keyed by service, e.g. {"linkedin":{"firstComment":"..."}} or {"youtube":{"title":"..."}}. A youtube object is merged over the stored YouTube settings; any other service object replaces the stored one.
actions.edit_post.props.mode.description: Leave empty to keep the post where it is. addToQueue, shareNext, customScheduled (needs Scheduled For) or shareNow (publishes immediately).
actions.edit_post.props.postId.descripti: The post to change, from List Posts or Create a Post.
actions.edit_post.props.saveToDraft.desc: yes to move the post back to drafts. Default no (keep its status).
actions.edit_post.props.schedulingType.d: Leave empty to keep it. automatic or notification.
actions.edit_post.props.tagIds.descripti: Replaces the post tags with these (IDs from List Tags). Leave empty to keep the tags.
actions.edit_post.props.text.description: New body text. Leave empty to keep the current text.
actions.get_channel.description: Get one Buffer channel with its posting schedule and service settings.
actions.get_channel.props.channelId.desc: The channel ID from List Channels.
actions.get_post.description: Get one Buffer post by ID.
actions.get_post.props.includeMetrics.de: yes to add this post's analytics and when they were last refreshed. Default no.
actions.get_post.props.postId.descriptio: The post ID from List Posts or Create a Post.
actions.get_post_metrics.description: Get totals and averages of post analytics over a date range.
actions.get_post_metrics.props.channelId: Only these channels (IDs from List Channels). Leave empty for every channel with insights.
actions.get_post_metrics.props.endDateTi: End of the window, inclusive, ISO 8601 with a timezone.
actions.get_post_metrics.props.organizat: The organization ID from List Organizations.
actions.get_post_metrics.props.startDate: Start of the window, inclusive, ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.
actions.get_post_metrics.props.tagIds.de: Only posts carrying any of these tags (IDs from List Tags).
actions.list_channels.description: List the social channels connected to a Buffer organization.
actions.list_channels.props.organization: The organization ID from List Organizations.
actions.list_idea_groups.description: List the columns of the Ideas board in a Buffer organization.
actions.list_idea_groups.props.organizat: The organization ID from List Organizations.
actions.list_ideas.description: List the saved ideas in a Buffer organization.
actions.list_ideas.props.cursor.descript: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, pass nextCursor from the previous call with the same filters.
actions.list_ideas.props.groupIds.descri: Only ideas in these board columns (IDs from List Idea Groups). Do not combine with Board Column.
actions.list_ideas.props.includeUntagged: With Tag IDs: yes to also return ideas that have no tags. Default no.
actions.list_ideas.props.limit.descripti: How many items to return in this page, 1 to 100. Default 20.
actions.list_ideas.props.membership.desc: grouped: only ideas in a column. ungrouped: only ideas outside every column. Leave empty for all. Do not combine with Group IDs.
The organization ID from List Organizations.
actions.list_ideas.props.tagIds.descript: Only ideas carrying any of these tags (IDs from List Tags).
actions.list_organizations.description: Get the connected Buffer account, its timezone and its organizations.
actions.list_posts.description: Search the posts of a Buffer organization by status, channel, tag and date.
actions.list_posts.props.channelIds.desc: Only posts on these channels (IDs from List Channels). Leave empty for all channels.
actions.list_posts.props.createdAfter.de: Only posts created at or after this time, ISO 8601 with a timezone.
actions.list_posts.props.createdBefore.d: Only posts created at or before this time, ISO 8601 with a timezone.
actions.list_posts.props.cursor.descript: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, pass nextCursor from the previous call with the same filters.
actions.list_posts.props.dueAfter.descri: Only posts scheduled at or after this time, ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.
actions.list_posts.props.dueBefore.descr: Only posts scheduled at or before this time, ISO 8601 with a timezone.
yes to add per-post analytics (reach, likes, …). Default no.
actions.list_posts.props.limit.descripti: How many items to return in this page, 1 to 100. Default 20.
The organization ID from List Organizations.
actions.list_posts.props.status.descript: Only posts with any of these statuses. Leave empty for all.
actions.list_posts.props.tagIds.descript: Only posts carrying any of these tags (IDs from List Tags).
actions.list_tags.description: List the tags of a Buffer organization.
actions.list_tags.props.cursor.descripti: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, pass nextCursor from the previous call with the same filters.
actions.list_tags.props.limit.descriptio: How many items to return in this page, 1 to 100. Default 20.
actions.list_tags.props.organizationId.d: The organization ID from List Organizations.
auth.description:
**How to get your Buffer API key:**

1. Sign in to Buffer and open **Settings → API** (https://publish.buffer.com/settings/api).
2. Click **Create key**, give it a name, and copy the key. Buffer shows it only once.
3. Paste it below.

The key acts as you: it reaches every organization and channel on your Buffer account. All your keys and MCP connections share one request limit (Free plan: 150 requests per 15 minutes and 600 per day).
description: Schedule, publish and analyze social media posts across multiple channels with Buffer.
triggers.new_channel.description: Triggers when a new channel is connected to your Buffer organization. Each check uses one Buffer API request, which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day).
triggers.new_queue_item.description: Triggers when a new post is queued in Buffer. Each check usually uses one Buffer API request (one more per 100 matching posts, at most 10 per check; any left over are picked up on the next check), which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day).
triggers.new_sent_item.description: Triggers when a Buffer post is successfully published. Each check usually uses one Buffer API request (one more per 100 posts sent in the last 24 hours, at most 10 per check), which counts against your plan limit (Free: 600 a day). If more than 1,000 posts are sent in one day, only the 1,000 with the latest scheduled times are checked.
